name: 44-trpc-maxbodysize-content-length
title: Reject oversized node-http request bodies up front
body: Instead of counting bytes as chunks arrive and erroring the stream midway, createBody now compares the request's Content-Length against maxBodySize before the body stream is created, so oversized uploads fail immediately with PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and the data handler only forwards chunks.

bugs.why: maxBodySize is now enforced only via the client-supplied Content-Length header; a chunked request (no Content-Length, Number(undefined) is NaN) or an understated length streams an unbounded body because onData no longer counts bytes.
